description: Creates the first report draft of a run whose figures a person has already approved in the app (run status approved). Any other status is rejected with the status named; regenerating an existing report is not possible here (it can mark edited texts for review or drop them) and stays in the app. Fynsight's own AI writes the driver sentences of the headlines and the three summary sentences from the computed figures and the published explanations, so the figures and explanation texts of this period are sent to Fynsight's AI provider (see data flows in the documentation). The result is a DRAFT: it is reviewed, published and signed off in the app. If building the report fails, the run goes to failed (a new run and a new approval are then needed). Returns the deeplink to the report.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.
